title: Adjustable Kitten Harness Vest with Wing Decoration
bullets: Vest-style harness listed for cats and small dogs, per the maker.
Buckle closure with a nylon fastener, per the maker's listing.
Listed material is polyester; the maker describes it as comfortable, adjustable, durable, and breathable.
Sizes S and M, in yellow, pink, blue, or purple, as listed for this product.
Weighs 150 g (0.33 lb). The maker lists machine wash as the care method.
description: Kittens and small pets need a harness that is light and easy to adjust. This vest-style kitten harness has a wing decoration and is listed for cats and small dogs. The maker lists it in sizes S and M, in yellow, pink, blue, and purple. The harness has a buckle closure and a nylon fastener, per the maker's listing. The maker describes it as comfortable, adjustable, durable, and breathable, and lists the material as polyester. It weighs 150 g (0.33 lb). The maker lists machine wash as the care method. Measure your pet before you order and check the fit before every use. Supervise your pet while the harness is on, and do not rely on any harness to keep a pet from slipping out. Stop using it if the straps, buckle, or stitching are damaged.

faq.a: This listing offers sizes S and M. Measure your pet before you order and check the fit before each use.
The maker lists machine wash as the care method. Check the fit again after washing before you put the harness on your pet.
Estimate: 3–5 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.

safety_warning: Supervise your pet at all times while the harness is on. Check the fit before every use. No harness can guarantee that a pet cannot slip out. Do not leave a pet unattended while it wears a harness. Stop using the harness if the straps, buckle, or stitching are damaged.
